subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Which Anthropic signed-thinking replay policy should OpenClaw adopt for completed prior turns now that recovery is mostly in place?
rationale: Current main has multiple recovery slices, but preventing replay of provider-signed thinking changes provider behavior and may affect tool-turn continuity or caching, so the final policy needs maintainer direction before another repair lane runs.

options.title: Sponsor scoped prevention
options.body: Land or adapt the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383-style approach: keep Fable/current tool-turn requirements, but stop replaying completed-turn signed thinking for the affected Claude paths with live Anthropic proof.

options.title: Keep recovery-only temporarily
options.body: Leave current main as a recovery-and-repair cushion while collecting more live examples of which completed-turn signatures are safe to omit.

options.title: Defer to broader session migration
options.body: Treat this as blocked behind the larger session/transcript migration work, accepting continued Anthropic replay exposure until that architecture lands.

recommendation.title: Sponsor scoped prevention
recommendation.body: Land or adapt the https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383-style approach: keep Fable/current tool-turn requirements, but stop replaying completed-turn signed thinking for the affected Claude paths with live Anthropic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already separated the merged recovery half from the still-open prevention half in the issue discussion.
